title: Computed Mechanism Animations
description:
Textbook organic reaction mechanisms, computed rather than drawn. For each reaction the transition state and intrinsic reaction coordinate are computed with DFT in implicit solvent (ORCA 6.1.1, SMD), with single points at M06-2X, B3LYP and DLPNO-CCSD(T) along the path; intrinsic bond orbitals are computed and tracked at every frame; and the result is shown as an interactive web viewer, a rendered video and a reaction card stating the level of theory, barrier and known limitations.
